breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 骨髓巨核细胞受JAK2（约55%）、CALR（约25%）或MPL（约4%）基因体细胞突变驱动，持续过度生产大量血小板（外周血持续≥450×10^9/L，常超1000×10^9/L）; 2) 过多的血小板不仅会在微血管及心脑大血管形成致命血栓（脑卒中、心梗、肢端红斑性灼痛），当血小板极度飙升（>1000–1500×10^9/L）时还会大量吸附消耗体内的vWF因子，反而引发“获得性血管性血友病”导致鼻出血或消化道大出血; 3) 总体病程呈慢性多年进展，少数晚期转化为骨髓纤维化或白血病。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 在各类骨髓增殖性肿瘤中预后最佳：极低危/低危年轻患者甚至仅需观察或口服小剂量阿司匹林；中高危患者通过羟基脲、阿那格雷或长效干扰素控制血小板计数，绝大多数患者可实现接近正常人的预期寿命（中位生存期常超过20年）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单列ET死因；规范危险分层管理下患者10年生存率超过85%–90%，主要死亡与并发血栓或少数晚期纤维化转化相关

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国单列死亡登记；国内IPSET-thrombosis分层体系显示合并JAK2突变及高龄患者血栓风险显著高于CALR突变者

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年ET靶向研发迎来精准分型突破：1) 全球首个靶向突变型CALR蛋白的单克隆抗体INCA033989在早期临床试验中展现出高度选择性地清除CALR突变克隆并快速使血小板正常化的惊艳疗效，现已推进至3期EXCALIBUR-ET研究; 2) 口服LSD1表观遗传抑制剂Bomedemstat正开展对比羟基脲的3期临床试验（Shorespan-007），为耐药患者提供新机制选择。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无获批药物能从根源彻底清除突变造血克隆并逆转远期骨髓纤维化转化风险; 2) 极高血小板患者的“血栓与出血双重矛盾”临床调控难度大; 3) 部分CALR突变患者对传统小剂量阿司匹林获益有限，个体化抗栓边界仍需细化。

curated.category: 罕见遗传性溶酶体贮积病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 常染色体隐性HEXA基因突变导致溶酶体β-氨基己糖苷酶A缺乏，GM2神经节苷脂在脑神经元内毒性堆积；最经典的婴儿型在出生3–6个月内看似正常，随后出现对声音过度惊跳、眼底“樱桃红斑”、视力丧失、全身肌张力崩溃与难治性癫痫，通常在2–5岁因吸入性肺炎或呼吸衰竭夭折（晚发型进展较慢）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前全球尚无任何获批的治愈或有效阻断神经退变的药物，临床仅能提供抗癫痫、胃造瘘防误吸、气道吸痰等舒缓与支持性照护；多款AAV基因治疗与底物减少疗法正在艰难探索中，预防的核心在于孕前携带者筛查与产前阻断。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet未单列全球年死亡人数，经典婴儿型几乎100%在5岁前死亡

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 一般人群活产发病率约1/320,000（Orphanet ORPHA:845），特定高发人群携带率可达1/27–1/30
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国属超罕见溶酶体贮积病，主要见于近亲结婚或携带者偶合家系，近年通过扩展性携带者筛查与全外显子测序偶有检出

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 癫痫持续状态与窒息气道抢救：1) 患儿出现连续抽搐>5分钟或呼吸微弱、口唇发绀，立即侧卧吸引口腔痰液并拨打120急救；2) 婴儿晚期吞咽反射消失，切忌强行经口喂奶喂水，防止致命性吸入性窒息。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系遗传排查与生育阻断（重中之重）：常染色体隐性遗传，患儿父母均为无症状携带者，每次妊娠有25%再发风险；父母、同胞及双方家族育龄亲属均应行HEXA基因及酶活性检测，再生育强烈建议通过PGT-M或羊水穿刺产前基因/酶学诊断
营养与气道舒缓护理：吞咽功能丧失后及时评估鼻饲管或经皮内镜胃造瘘（PEG），配备家用吸痰器与血氧仪预防吸入性肺炎
家庭心理哀伤辅导与儿童安宁疗护支持

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 针对GM2神经节苷脂贮积症的双顺反子AAV9基因疗法（如AXO-AAV-GM2、TSHA-101）曾进入早期人体试验，但因超罕见病资金与入组挑战部分项目经历赞助方调整或暂停；2) 小分子葡萄糖神经酰胺合成酶抑制剂Venglustat（底物减少疗法）在晚发型GM2临床试验中探索能否减少神经节苷脂合成；3) 造血干细胞移植（HSCT）在极早期无症状或晚发型中尝试过但对经典婴儿型效果有限。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 经典婴儿型进展极快，尚无能穿过血脑屏障有效补充HEXA酶活性的获批药物；2) 超罕见病临床试验受限于患者基数极小与商业回报低，多款基因疗法推进艰难；3) 婚检与孕前扩展性携带者基因筛查普及率低。

master.definition_en: Acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes related to radiation represent a subgroup of therapy-related myeloid neoplasms (t-MN), associated with treatment of an unrelated neoplastic disease with radiation. The neoplastic cells typically harbor unbalanced aberrations of chromosomes 5 and 7 (monosomy 5/del(5q) and monosomy 7/del(7q)) or a complex karyotype. Patients frequently present with multilineage dysplasia and cytopenias 5-10 years after exposure.

master.name_en: combined hamartoma of the retina and retinal pigment epithelium
master.definition_en: A rare benign eye tumor characterized by the presence of glial cells, vascular tissue, and sheets of pigment epithelial cells lacking the distribution and organization of the normal retina and retinal pigment epithelium. The lesion is most commonly found unilaterally as a slightly elevated mass in a peripapillary location but can also occur in the macula or the retinal periphery. It is sometimes associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 or 2, nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, or branchio-oculo-facial syndrome. Patients may be asymptomatic or present with progressive loss of vision.

master.definition_en: A clonal hematopoietic disorder characterized by dysplasia and ineffective hematopoiesis in one or more of the hematopoietic cell lines. curated.category: 血液系统恶性肿瘤 / 克隆性髓系肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 造血干细胞克隆性病态造血导致无效造血与外周血一系或多系减少；低危组主要因长期重度贫血输血铁过载器官损伤历数年恶化，高危组约1/3在数月至数年内向继发性AML转化，亦可突发致命重度感染或颅内出血。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 异基因造血干细胞移植是目前唯一根治手段但高龄患者多不耐受；低危组侧重改善贫血与减少输血依赖（罗特西普2025年底进常规药品保障大幅利好！），较高危组依赖集采去甲基化药物(阿扎胞苷/地西他滨)延缓向AML转化。

master.definition_en: La Crosse encephalitis (CE) is an acute arboviral infection caused by the La Crosse bunyavirus transmitted by an infected mosquito, usually observed in infants, children or adolescents (6 months to 16 years), and characterized by the onset of flulike symptoms such as fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, headache, and abdominal pain, followed by the onset of encephalitis characterized by somnolence, obtundation, and even seizures, focal neurologic signs (asymmetrical reflexes or Babinski signs), paralysis or even coma. CE can leave sequelae such as residual epilepsy and neurocognitive deficits.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。

master.name_en: Anomalous aortic origin of the right coronary artery
master.definition_en: A rare coronary artery congenital malformation characterized by an anomalous origin and course of the right coronary artery, which originates from the left aortic sinus of Valsalva and has an abnormal proximal course, which may be intramural, prepulmonic, subpulmonic, retroaortic, retrocardiac or wrapped around the apex. Patients are frequently asymptomatic, although chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations, dizziness, syncope, and sudden cardiac arrest/death (typically following intense physical exertion) may be observed. This malformation is associated with a lower risk of sudden cardiac death therefore surgical revascularization is recommended only when signs and/or symptoms of ischemia are present.
synonyms_en: Right coronary artery from left aortic sinus

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
